entries.title: Static site rebuild
items: Rebuilt the game project with Vite, React, and TypeScript.
Removed advertising, analytics, and third-party captured cache files.
Added a static site generation architecture with JSON-managed content.
Prepared Home, About, Contact US, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Change Log, Sitemap, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml outputs.
